pack_resume.py.content:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,time,zipfile,hashlib

R=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=json.loads((R/'RESULTS.json').read_text()) if (R/'RESULTS.json').exists() else []
old=json.loads((R.parent/'r3_restore/r2/buffer_growth/RESULTS.json').read_text())
lines=['# R3 — checkpoint sementara','',datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Jakarta')).isoformat(),'','R3 belum selesai; belum ada pemenang akhir. Semua angka berikut berasal dari laporan raw lengkap yang sudah diaudit, bukan saldo sementara.','','|ID|Jalur|Biaya|Saldo USD|DD %|Delta saldo vs R2 USD|Delta DD vs R2 poin %|Audit|','|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|']
for x in rows:
    y=next(a for a in old if a['id']=='BUFFER_EUR_BTC_V2_CANDIDATE' and a['way']==x['way'] and a['cost']==x['cost'])
    lines.append(f"|{x['id']}|{x['way']}|{x['cost']}|{x['balance']:,.2f}|{x['dd']:.6f}|{x['balance']-y['balance']:+,.2f}|{x['dd']-y['dd']:+.6f}|{x['pass']}|")
lines+=['','Batas lama: worst DD enam ≤72.21320348415222%; minimum saldo A/B biaya2× ≥842853657.6189626. Lolos audit akuntansi tidak sama dengan lolos syarat profit/DD. BUFFER V1, XAU, BTC32 dan LIVE tetap.','','Proses riil saat snapshot tercatat di JOB.json dan replay.log. STATUS.json adalah snapshot; tidak menjamin worker masih hidup setelah lingkungan terputus. Baca PLAN.json dan run_r3.py untuk kelanjutan. Hasil akhir dituju ke Library libfile_2debd92450a88191901de3687568103a; jangan menganggap file target sudah berisi hasil akhir sebelum FINAL_STATUS dan receipt berhasil tersedia.']
(R/'PROGRESS.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
raw={x['file']:x['sha256'] for x in rows}
snapshot={'snapshot_utc':time.time(),'status':json.loads((R/'STATUS.json').read_text()),'audited_completed_scenarios':len(rows),'all_audits_pass':all(x['pass'] for x in rows),'no_final_winner_yet':True,'results_archive_target':'libfile_2debd92450a88191901de3687568103a','progress':{}}
for p in R.glob('*/replay.log'):
    a=p.read_text().splitlines();snapshot['progress'][p.parent.name]=a[-1] if a else 'loading'
manifest={};tmp=R.parent/'RIZAN_R3_RESUME_20261028.tmp'
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for p in sorted(R.rglob('*')):
        if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink() or '__pycache__' in p.parts or p.name.endswith('.tmp'):continue
        rel=str(p.relative_to(R))
        if p.suffix=='.gz' and rel not in raw:continue
        if '.btc_signals.' in p.name:continue
        data=p.read_bytes()
        if rel in raw:assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==raw[rel]
        name='r3_research/'+rel;z.writestr(name,data,compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_STORED if p.suffix=='.gz' else zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED);manifest[name]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    z.writestr('SNAPSHOT.json',json.dumps(snapshot,indent=2));z.writestr('SHA256.json',json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
out=R.parent/'RIZAN_R3_RESUME_20261028.zip';tmp.replace(out)
with zipfile.ZipFile(out) as z:assert all(hashlib.sha256(z.read(k)).hexdigest()==v for k,v in manifest.items())
print(json.dumps({'file':str(out),'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'entries':len(manifest),'audited_runs':len(rows)}))
